text: How does the hat decide? If bravery is the highest score, what house should they be in?
Think of the hat's logic as a tree. First it asks: Is bravery > 7? If yes, branch left. If no, branch right.
If you need to search 3000 students for a match, checking each one individually is slow (O(n)). How do you search a sorted list faster?
Look into the mathematical concept of Binary Search. It repeatedly divides the search interval in half.
Python has a built-in module for binary search. Check out the `bisect` module, specifically `bisect_left`.
